description.narrative: UN Global Pulse (UNGP) is an initiative of the Executive Office of Secretary-General (EOSG) founded in 2009. UNGP serves as a cross-pillar lead and hub for experimentation and digital innovation. Its vision is ‘A world in which responsible and inclusive digital innovation serves to empower people and protect the planet’. Its mission is to work at the intersection of digital innovation and science to inform, inspire and support the entire UN and those it serves, to anticipate and respond to the challenges of today and tomorrow. The UNGP Finland project will serve as Global Pulse Network’s operational hub and will host 2 of the capabilities outlined in the network strategy. UNGP Finland aims to support the delivery of the UN Secretary General’s broader transformation strategy through a ‘Quintet of Change, with a focus on Strategic Foresight, Innovation Scaling and Performance & Results Orientation, as well as UN 2.0.\n
